……でも、無理もだめだよ。ちゃんと食べなきゃ力が出ないんじゃないかな。お母さんを: "...Still, don't push yourself too hard, okay? If you don't eat properly, you won't have any energy. It'd be terrible if you couldn't walk around looking for your mom anymore."
男の子は目を細める。町の景色に視線を投げ、じっと見ていた。: The boy narrowed his eyes. He cast his gaze over the view of the town, staring at it intently.
あなたのお母さん。どこにいるんだろうね。早く見つかったらいいね: "Your mom. I wonder where she is. I hope we find her soon."
あのね。もし嫌なこと聞いてたら、ごめんね: "Hey. If I'm asking something you don't want to talk about, I'm sorry, okay?"
男の子が私を見上げる。色のない瞳に見つめられ、私は微笑みながら、言う。: The boy looked up at me. Gazed at by those colorless eyes, I smiled and spoke.
……お母さんに会えたら、どうしたい？ 何か言いたいこととか、やってもらいたいこと: "...When you get to see your mom, what do you want to do? Is there anything you want to say to her, or anything you want her to do for you?"
男の子は、抱いていた子猫をぎゅっとした――抱きしめてもらいたい。ただ、それだけ。: The boy gave the kitten he was holding a tight squeeze--he wanted to be hugged. Just that. I felt like I saw that small "feeling" of his.
私の“半透明”な胸の奥がずきりと痛んだ。: Deep inside my "translucent" chest, a sharp pain throbbed.
ため息をつき、言った。: I let out a sigh and spoke.
こんなに、こんなに、あなたが会いたいって思ってるのに。それなのに、あなたの会いた: "Even though you want to see her this much, this badly. Even so, those 'feelings' of yours just won't easily reach the precious person you want to see."
もしも男の子の“お母さんに会いたい”という“想い”が、言葉にせずとも、誰の目にも: If only the boy's "feeling" of "wanting to see his mom" could take on a "form" obvious to anyone's eyes, without needing to be put into words...
男の子のお母さんは、すぐにでも男の子のことを見つけてくれるんじゃないだろうか――: Wouldn't the boy's mother find him right away?--Wouldn't she forgive what unpleasant adults call "selfishness" with a smile?
どうして“想い”は目に見えないのだろう。この世界には、目に見えないのに大切なもの: Why are "feelings" invisible to the eye? This world is overflowing with so many things that are precious, yet invisible.
懸命に伝えようとする言葉だけでは、決して言い表せない“想い”が、もしも目に見える: If the "feelings" that can never be fully expressed through words alone, no matter how hard we try to convey them, were something visible to the eye...
もっともっと人とひとは、心と心は、大切に繋がりあえることも増えるんじゃないだろう: Wouldn't people, and their hearts, be able to connect with each other in a precious way so much more often?
だから昔から人間は、言葉だけでは表せない“想い”を絵にしたり、物語にしたり、歌に: Maybe that's why, since long ago, humans have tried to turn the "feelings" that can't be expressed in words alone into paintings, into stories, and into songs, to deliver them to the people precious to them.
そう思うと……。: When I think of it that way...
そうしたたくさんの“想い”が重なりできている――そんなこの世界がとても愛しく、眩: Made up of so many of those overlapping "feelings"--this world ended up looking so very dear, and so dazzling to me.
本当はとても残酷で。とても、冷たい。そしてさみしい。: In truth, it's very cruel. Very cold. And lonely.
そんな“想い”ばかりがここには降り重なっているけれど……。: Even though nothing but "feelings" like those are piled up here...
悲しみやさみしさの中にこそ、うつくしく輝く“光り”と“未来”があるのだと信じたい: I want to believe that it is precisely within sadness and loneliness that a beautifully shining "light" and "future" exist.
そういうふうに感じる“想い”を、昔々の誰かは“希望”とか“夢”だとか。……“愛”: Maybe someone long, long ago took the "feelings" that make you feel that way and gave them names like "hope" or "dreams"... or "love" or "courage."
大人たちが聞いたら失笑されそうなことを平気で思える私はやっぱり、まだまだ子どもで: Being able to casually think things that would make adults laugh if they heard them means that, sure enough, I'm still very much a child...
そんな自分が結構、私は嫌いじゃないかな。: And I don't think I really dislike that part of myself.
よし。それじゃあ休憩はこれくらいにして、今日もあともう少しだけ、歩いてみよう: "Alright. Let's wrap up our break here and walk around just a little more today."
まだあそこら辺は探してないよね。と、私は町を指さした。: "We haven't searched around that area yet, right?" I said, pointing toward the town.
今日も一日町を歩き回って……夜になり、私たちは時計塔の管理室に戻ってきた。: After walking around town all day again today... night fell, and we returned to the clock tower's office.
開かれた窓から外を見る――“夜”よりもせわしなく、鋭い光りの瞬く夜だ。: I looked outside through the open window--it was a night more restless than the "Night," twinkling with sharp lights.
“探し物は見つけにくいものなのだから、いくら探してみてもそう簡単には見つからない: "'Because lost things are hard to find, no matter how much you look for them, they won't be found so easily'--somewhere, I had heard a song sung like that many times."
それはきっと誰もが知ってるはずの名曲だった。: It was surely a famous song that everyone must know.
……[・|歌]は色々なことを教えてくれる。: Songs teach us all sorts of things.
この歌を作った人はいったい、この世界の中にどんな宝物を探していたんだろうか。: What kind of treasure in this world was the person who wrote this song looking for, I wonder?
あなたのお母さんのお家、見つけられたね。がんばって歩いた成果だって思ってもいいか: "We found your mom's house, didn't we? I wonder if we can think of it as the result of us working hard and walking so much."
そうだ。[・|私][・|た][・|ち][・|は]、[・|探][・|し][・|求]: That's right. We found the treasure we had been searching for.
……でももう、引っ越しちゃってる後みたいだったね: "...Though it looked like she had already moved away."
見つけられたのは宝箱だけ。肝心な箱の中は空っぽだった。: All we managed to find was the treasure chest. The crucial inside of the chest was empty.
チャイムを鳴らしてみても、誰も、応えてくれなかったし……: "Even when we rang the doorbell, nobody answered..."
あなたと子猫と、そして私……。[・|三][・|人]で窓から家の中を覗き込んでみた: You, the kitten, and me... The three of us peered inside the house through the window.
そこには家具もなにもなく、生活の気配は感じられなかった。: There was no furniture or anything in there, and no sign of life could be felt.
その家を見つけたのは子猫だ。男の子がいつも抱いて歩いている黒い猫。: The one who found that house was the kitten. The black cat the boy always carries in his arms as he walks.
……公園での休憩を終えた後、町を歩いた。: After finishing our break at the park, we walked through the town.
かつては活気があったのだろう商店街や、石の階段をたくさんのぼった先にある立派な神: A shopping district that must have once been lively, and a magnificent shrine at the top of a long flight of stone steps.
通りすがるそれらは全部、こぼれ落ちそうなほどいっぱいのさくら色に満たされている。: Everything we passed by was filled to the brim with cherry-blossom pink, almost overflowing.
満開の春に彩られた町並みには、決して私たちには関わることのできない――: In the townscape colored by spring in full bloom, when I thought about how the lives of people whom we could never get involved with--
どころか知ることさえないのだろう人々の人生が、幾重にも折り重なっているのかと思う: Or rather, whom we would probably never even know, were layered upon one another so many times over, it gave me a strange feeling.
神社は、町の人たちが共同で管理するようになって長いのだと、石段の麓に立てられた看: According to a sign standing at the base of the stone steps, the shrine had long since come to be jointly managed by the townspeople.
今はもうここに住む神主だったり巫女だったりはいないようだけど……。: It seemed there were no longer any priests or shrine maidens living here now, though...
男の子のお母さんが早く見つかりますようにと並んで祈り、賽銭箱には男の子が、残った: Standing side by side, we prayed that the boy's mother would be found soon, and from his remaining loose change, the boy dropped one ten-yen coin and one five-yen coin into the offering box.
『あ、それ知ってるよ。五円と十円が一枚ずつで、“[ごえん|御縁]が充分ありますよ: "'Oh, I know that one! One five-yen coin and one ten-yen coin is a good-luck charm asking for "plenty of good fortune and connections," right?'"
得意そうに言っちゃったのは、物知りなところを見せて、ちょっとお姉さんぶりたいとこ: The reason I said it so proudly was partly because I wanted to show off how knowledgeable I was and act a little like an older sister.
でも、男の子はいつものように何も言わず無表情なまま、ただ首をかしげるだけだった。: However, just like always, the boy said nothing and remained expressionless, merely tilting his head.
神社の石段を降りきると、男の子の腕から子猫がぴょんと飛び降り、どこかへとてとて走: Once we made it all the way down the shrine's stone steps, the kitten hopped right out of the boy's arms and pattered off, running somewhere.
男の子と一緒に追いかけた先には、閉店してしまったお店が軒をずらりと並べる、さっき: Chasing after it together with the boy led us to a different shopping district from the one we had passed through earlier, lined with row after row of shuttered shops.
すっかり廃れてしまった喫茶店の前を通る。: We passed in front of a completely run-down cafe.
お店の中には、立派な蓄音機がひとつと、レコードがたくさん並ぶ棚が、窓越しに見えた: Through the window, we could see a single magnificent gramophone inside the shop, along with shelves lined with lots of records.
なんだか懐かしい気持ちになる。: It made me feel somewhat nostalgic.
“夜”の中ではいつも“歌”を聞いていた。: Inside the "Night," I was always listening to "songs."
時計塔の管理室で音楽に心を澄ませ、本を読み、物語を見上げた小さな天井に思い描いて: In the clock tower's office, I would quiet my heart to the music, read books, and picture the stories across the small ceiling above me.
まだ“夜”から“外”へ出て数日と経っていないのに、もう随分と“歌”を聴いていない: Even though only a few days had passed since we left the "Night" for the "Outside," I found myself thinking that it had already been quite a while since I listened to a "song," or touched a story or a painting--come to think of it, the "Night" had been filled with all kinds of colors.
“外”はやっぱりなんだかさみしい。音も光りも色彩も。少し、少ない。: The "Outside" really did feel somewhat lonely. The sounds, the light, and the colors. There were just a little fewer of them.
ふと、ため息をついてしまったところで……。: Just as I let out a sudden sigh...
子猫が数メートル先にちょこんと座り、私たちを待っていた。: The kitten was sitting primly a few meters ahead, waiting for us.
駆け足で追いつくと、更にまた子猫は歩いて行き――裏路地をいくつか曲がり、進んでい: When we jogged to catch up, the kitten started walking again--turning down several back alleys, and at the end of where it led us stood that house.
ごくふつうの住宅だった。: It was a completely ordinary home.
特別、何か際立つ特徴があるわけでもない。: There wasn't anything particularly striking about it.
でも見覚えのある家だった。: Yet it was a house I recognized.
男の子の心に触れた際、見たものと良くよく似ていた。: It closely resembled what I had seen when I touched the boy's heart.
ちらりと隣の男の子の顔を見る。: I glanced at the face of the boy beside me.
するとその瞳の中に“ここが、ぼくの家だ”――そういう“想い”を、私は見たのだった: And in his eyes, I saw that "feeling"--"This is my house."
ねえ。あなたは、男の子のお家の場所、知ってたのかな: "Hey. Did you know where the boy's house was?"
だけどやっぱり私には興味がないようだ。にゃあとも鳴かず、ただそっぽを向くだけだっ: However, it still didn't seem to have any interest in me. Without so much as a meow, it simply looked the other way.
男の子は膝の上に座る子猫の身体を、ゆっくり、丁寧に撫で続けていた。: The boy continued to slowly and carefully stroke the body of the kitten sitting on his lap.
ごろごろと咽を鳴らす子猫の存在に、何か、理由のない安心をもらえないかと、そう祈っ: For some reason, it looked to me as though he were praying that the presence of the purring kitten might grant him some kind of groundless peace of mind.
これからどうしようか。: What should we do from here on?
そんなこと言えもせず――窓の外に、ふと視線を投げた。: Unable to even voice such a question--I cast my gaze out the window.
淡い瞬きを繰り返す夜の景色がそこにはある。: Out there lay a nightscape repeating its faint twinkling.
でももう、この景色の中に“宝物”はないのだとわかってしまった。: But I now knew that the "treasure" was no longer within this scenery.
そんな“答え”だけが、淡い光りの中に瞬いているようにも思えた。: It felt as if only that "answer" was flickering amid the faint light.
男の子が急に立ち上がり、窓をぱたりと、締めてしまった。: The boy suddenly stood up and shut the window with a click.
そう問いかける私を、男の子は振り返り、: As I asked that, the boy looked back at me,
ふるふると、首を横に振った。: and shook his head from side to side.
そして私の目をじっと見、また首を振るのだった。: Then he stared straight into my eyes and shook his head once more.
最初は、何を言いたいのかわからなかったけれど……“もう、いいよ”: At first, I didn't know what he was trying to say, but..."It's okay now."
男の子はそう言いたいのではないかと、私には思えた……“もういいよ。ありがとう”: It felt to me like that was what the boy wanted to say..."It's okay now. Thank you."
“ぼくのお母さんはこの町にはもういない”: "My mom isn't in this town anymore."
聞こえないはずの声が、見えないはずの“想い”が、手に取るように感じられてしまった: A voice I shouldn't have been able to hear, and "feelings" I shouldn't have been able to see, could be felt as clearly as if I were holding them in my hands.
それは気のせいかもしれないし、ただの思い込みかもしれないけれど……。: It might have just been my imagination, or maybe just wishful thinking, though...
そのとき男の子が、無言のままに浮かべた微かな表情が……。: The faint expression that surfaced on the boy's face in silence at that moment...
どうしようもなく、私の胸の奥をずきりとさせた。: Sent an unbearable, sharp pang deep into my chest.
小さな窓枠に腰掛けて、夜の景色を眺めていた。: Sitting on the small windowsill, I gazed out at the night scenery.
男の子は子猫と一緒に、テーブルの下で眠りについている。: The boy was fast asleep under the table along with the kitten.
“夜”の中ではここに座って、大雅と色々な話をしたなあと思い出す。: I remembered how, inside the "Night," I used to sit right here and talk about all sorts of things with Taiga.
覚悟を決めたはずだった。: I was supposed to have made up my mind.
様々な覚悟をだ。: To have resolved myself to all sorts of things.
それなのに今、どうして私はここにいるんだっけ。: And yet, why am I here right now?
……どうして、今、私の隣にはあなたがいないんだったっけ。: Why aren't you beside me right now, again?
ずきりと胸が痛むのは、さみしさからか、悲しさからか……。: Was this sharp ache in my chest coming from loneliness, or from sadness...?
そういった言葉にしづらい“想い”を、忘れることなんてやっぱりできず――眠る必要も: Still unable to forget those hard-to-put-into-words "feelings"--I, who didn't even need to sleep, simply stared motionlessly out at the town slumbering at the bottom of the night.
この町に、男の子のお母さんはいなかった。それがここ数日に渡る、私たちの宝探しの結: The boy's mother wasn't in this town. That was the result of our treasure hunt over the past few days.
たどり着いた家のあの様子では、もう随分前に引っ越していったのだろうと感じる。: Judging by the state of the house we finally reached, I felt she must have moved away quite a long time ago.
……もう、私の役目は終わったのかな: "...I wonder if my role is already over."
そもそも誰に頼まれたでも、願われたでもなくて: "In the first place, nobody asked me to do this, and nobody wished for it."
……ただ私が勝手に、あの男の子のそばにくっついていただけだよね。誰かが私を必要と: "...I was just sticking by that boy's side all on my own, wasn't I? Even though nobody actually needs me."
……いつか“夜”でまた大雅と逢えたら、よろこんでくれるんじゃないかって、思って: "...I just thought that if I ever met Taiga again in the 'Night' someday, it might make him happy."
あなたの笑顔ならどんなふうにしたって、ひとつでも多く見つめていたい。: When it comes to your smile, no matter what it takes, I want to gaze at even one more of them.
大雅が助けたこの子を、最後まで、助けきることができたなら……。: If I could see things through to the very end and finish saving this child whom Taiga saved...
そうすることで、大雅がこの世界に生きたことの証明になるような気がして……。: I felt like doing so would become proof that Taiga had lived in this world...
もう、いいよね。これ以上、私は何もできない: "It's enough now, right? I can't do anything more than this."
男の子の手に託された大雅の“力”: Taiga's "power" entrusted to the boy's hand.
それを受け取り“夜”へと戻ろう。: I'll receive it and return to the "Night."
“お母さんに会いたい”――男の子の願いだ。: "I want to see my mom"--that was the boy's wish.
“お母さんに抱きしめてもらいたい”――男の子の祈りだ。: "I want my mom to hug me"--that was the boy's prayer.
それらはすべて叶わないと、わかったから。: Because we had learned that none of those would come true.
その結末もまた、ひとつの結果だ。: That ending, too, was a result in itself.
何気なく名前を呼んでみただけのつもりだった。: I had only meant to call out his name casually.
……悲しくはないはずだった。: I wasn't supposed to be sad.
“夜”に戻ればまた必ず逢えるとわかってる。: I knew that if I returned to the "Night," we would definitely meet again.
それなのに涙がたったひとつ、ぽろりと落ちたのはなぜだろう。: And yet, why did a single tear fall down my cheek?
どうしようもなく悲しいと思ってしまうのは、どうしてなのかな。: Why do I find myself feeling so hopelessly sad?
大雅と一緒に“未来”を生きてみたかった。: I had wanted to try living in the "future" together with Taiga.
うれしいときも、さみしいときも、悲しみが溢れてやまないときも――あなたと一緒に泣: In happy times, in lonely times, and in times when sorrow overflowed endlessly--I had wanted to try crying and laughing together with you.
“外の世界”でそれを叶えたいと、ふたり、手と手を繋いで“夜”に願いをかけたのだ。: Wishing to make that come true in the "Outside World," the two of us had joined hands and made a wish upon the "Night."
もし、そうして思い描いた時間が叶うなら、何が起きようともそのすべての時間が幸せだ: If the time we envisioned like that had come true, then no matter what happened, every single moment of it would have been happy.
そんな“想い”が、言葉にするまでもなく私の胸に溢れてる。: Such "feelings" were overflowing in my chest without even needing to be put into words.
……今すぐあなたに、逢いたいよ: "...I want to see you right this second."
この涙はそんな“想い”の形だと、わかった。: I realized that this tear was the shape of those "feelings."
微かな鈴の音がして、驚き――振り向く。: Startled by the faint sound of a bell--I turned around.
すると男の子がそこに立っていた。じっと私を見つめてる。: The boy was standing right there, staring fixedly at me.
バレないようにさっと涙を拭いて、微笑んでみた。: I quickly wiped away my tear so he wouldn't notice and gave him a smile.
こくりとうなずく男の子。: The boy gave a small nod.
その不安定な視線から、形にならない声を聞いた――“眠れない。全然”: From his wavering gaze, I heard an unformed voice--"I can't sleep. Not at all."
腕には子猫をしっかりと抱いたままだった。: He was still holding the kitten tightly in his arms.
独り言、聞かれちゃったかなと心配に思った。: I worried that he might have overheard me talking to myself.
でもその心配はないようだ。男の子は小さな頭を眠そうにふらふらとさせている。: But it seemed I didn't need to worry about that. The boy's small head was swaying sleepily.
……眠気はあるのに眠れない。: He was sleepy, yet he couldn't fall asleep.
目を閉じると怖い“未来”ばかりが脳裏を過ぎる――お母さん。……お母さん。どうして: Whenever he closed his eyes, nothing but frightening "futures" flashed through his mind--Mom. ...Mom. Why did you leave me behind? I don't understand. I don't understand, Mom.
胸に溢れて消えない“想い”が苦しいのだと言わんばかりに、私のことを、不安そうに見: He looked up at me uneasily, as if to say that the "feelings" overflowing in his chest and refusing to fade were painful.
少し考え、私は言った。: After thinking for a moment, I spoke.
そう言った私に、男の子は不思議そうに首をかしげた。: When I said that, the boy tilted his head curiously.
……うん。あのね。私のお母さんがね、今夜のあなたと同じように、何でだかどうしても: "...Yeah. You see, it reminded me of something my mom used to tell me all the time on nights when, just like you tonight, I somehow couldn't fall asleep no matter what."
胸がずきりとする。色々な“想い”がまぜこぜになった痛みだった。: A sharp pang shot through my chest. It was an ache made of all sorts of "feelings" jumbled together.
その痛みを誤魔化せたらと願い、私は微笑む。: Hoping to hide that pain, I smiled.
眠れない夜は羊を数えるって言うでしょう？ 羊が一匹、羊が二匹って。それもいいけど: "People say to count sheep on nights when you can't sleep, right? One sheep, two sheep. That's fine too, but counting 'dreams' is much, much more effective."
まだ私にやさしかった頃のお母さんが、同じ枕に頭を沈め、笑顔で、そう語ってくれた。: Back when she was still kind to me, my mother had rested her head on the same pillow as mine and told me that with a smile.
だから私ね、[・|地][・|下][・|室][・|の][・|ベ][・|ッ][・|ド: "So whenever I was sad, lonely, and couldn't sleep in my bed in the basement, I would remember that. I'd 'imagine' 'dreams' of how I wished things would turn out--though I guess in this case, they might have been 'daydreams.'"
まあどっちでもいいんだけれどね。: Well, either way is fine, though.
命あるもの達が必死に生きた[人生|物語]を、そういうふうに形にしたい。: I want to give that kind of shape to the stories of the lives that living beings fought so desperately to live.

そんな大雅に親切にしてくれる人もたくさんいた。肩を貸しましょうかという人もいた。: There were many people who were kind to Taiga as he was. There were even people who offered to lend him a shoulder. However, Taiga turned all of them down with a smile.

肩を貸してあげられればよかった。: I wished I could have lent him a shoulder.

（今のわたしに、できることなんて……）: (What I can do right now is...)
きみのあたらしいその“夢”を、この命ぜんぶ使って応援することだけだ。: To use every bit of this life to cheer on that new "dream" of yours.
特殊な病気に苦しむ人たちと会うために、とある山の上の病院へと向かう途中。: On his way to a hospital atop a certain mountain to meet people suffering from a special illness...
頭の中にある後遺症の発作だ――うずくまり、震え、ついには倒れた。: It was a seizure from the aftereffects inside his head--he crouched down, trembled, and finally collapsed.

わたしは人を呼ぼうと駆け回った。: I ran around trying to call for help.

大雅のことを助けてくれる人たちを見守って。: Watching over the people who came to save Taiga.
そのまま草むらの中で少し休もうと瞼を閉じて。: Closing my eyelids in the tall grass just as I was, trying to rest for a little while.

わたしはまた別の柄の子猫に産まれる。: I was born again as a kitten with a different coat.
確か六つ目の“命”だ。: If I remember right, this is my sixth "life."
“参禅町”に戻ると、大雅の匂いがした。: When I returned to Sanzen Town, I caught Taiga's scent.
いつもと同じように、窓から“ゆめのねどこ”の中をこっそり覗いた。: Just like always, I secretly peeked inside the "Bed of Dreams" through the window.

（……きみのしようとしてることなら、どんなことでも全部、上手くいくよう祈ってる）: (...If it's something you're trying to do, whatever it is, I'm praying that all of it goes well.)

（よかった……。まだちゃんと、この姿になれた）: (Thank goodness... I can still properly take this form.)

[・|ま][・|る][・|で][・|制][・|限][・|時][・|間][・|に]: As if being hounded by a time limit, Taiga continued to write something.

たぶん、手紙だろうとわたしは思う。: Maybe, I thought, it was a letter.

大雅ががんばってること。大雅が“夢”を叶えようと懸命になってること。大雅が、ひと: How hard Taiga is trying. How desperately Taiga is working to make his "dream" come true. How earnestly Taiga is living, even all on his own.

できるだけかわいくてきれいな花を集めて作った花束と、拾った百円玉で買ったサバ缶も: Along with a bouquet made from gathering the cutest, prettiest flowers I could find, and a can of mackerel I bought with a hundred-yen coin I had picked up.
早朝。それに気づいた大雅はその場で手紙を開き、読んで、きょろきょろと辺りを見渡す: Early in the morning. Noticing it, Taiga opened the letter right there on the spot, read it, and looked around restlessly.
驚いたような顔をしていたけれど、花束に少し頬を緩ませていたように見えた。: He had a surprised look on his face, yet his cheeks seemed to soften slightly at the sight of the bouquet.
いつも後遺症のしびれや痛みで、ここ最近はずっと顔をしかめていることが多かった。で: Lately, he had spent so much time frowning from the constant numbness and pain of his aftereffects. Even so, I felt like I had been able to see him smile for the first time in a long while.
その笑顔をわたしが作れたのなら、うれしい。とても。: If I was the one who managed to bring about that smile, I'm happy. So very happy.
……“想い”は届いた。きみに、届いた。そう思った。: My "feelings" reached him. They reached you. That was what I thought.

七つ目も、八つ目も、殆ど変わらない。: The seventh and the eighth were hardly any different.

……それだけきみもまた歳を取った。家の中を歩くのもつらそうなのは、後遺症のせいな: And by that same measure, you grew older too. Was it because of the aftereffects that even walking around inside the house looked painful for you, or was it because of the time that had accumulated within your body?

わたしは“夜のイキモノ”: I am a "Creature of the Night."
きみとは生きる時間が違うけど……。: The time I live through is different from yours, though...

じりじりと列車のベルが鳴る。: The train bell rings with a shrill buzz.

そう言い、ふっと女の子が微笑んだ。: Saying that, the girl offered a gentle smile.
私と同じくらいの小さなちいさな女の子。: A tiny little girl, just about the same size as me.
それなのにその微笑みはどこか大人びていて――あのときの私には、その子がソルやナハ: And yet, her smile was somehow mature--and to me back then, she looked like a savior who would help Sol and Nacht.
私はその子に泣きながら事情を話した。: Through my tears, I explained the situation to her.
……残念だけど、言いにくいことだけれど……。ごめんね。あなたの探しているひとは、: "...It's unfortunate, and hard for me to say, but... I'm sorry. I don't think you'll find the person you're looking for, no matter how much you search."
女の子は泣いてばかりの私から目を伏せる。: The girl lowered her eyes away from me as I kept crying.
そして、私のまだまだ知らない“夜”について教えてくれたのだった。: And then, she told me about aspects of the "Night" I still knew nothing about.
ソルは、大切な人と命を交換した。: Sol had exchanged his life with someone precious to him.
いわばその命は娘さんと一心同体。: So to speak, that life was one and the same with his daughter's.
ソルの時間はとっくに尽きてる。故に。この“夜”に産まれ直すようなことはない――彼: Sol's time had run out long ago. Therefore, he would not be reborn into this "Night"--saying "goodbye" to him meant the true "end."
……一度さよならをしてしまったものとはもう二度と、会えない。それが命に備わった本: "...Once you've said goodbye to something, you can never meet it again. That is the fundamental rule built into life."
……これくらいのことなら、どんなに小さくても、どんなに、子どものように見えていて: "...Something like this, no matter how small you are, no matter how much like a child you might look--"
人間は思いの外、かしこくて。小さくてもそうでなくても色々と、たくさん、たくさん考: "Humans are surprisingly clever. Whether they're small or not, they are creatures that live while thinking about all sorts of things, so, so very much..."
だからこれくらいのこと、わざわざ言われなくても――: "So you already know this much without having to be told--"
だから私は泣いてる。誰か助けてと願い続けてる。: That was why I was crying. Why I kept wishing for someone to save us.
小さな私は、小さな女の子に問いかけた。: Little me asked the little girl.
……ナハトにソルを返したい: "...I want to give Sol back to Nacht."
手のひらに乗せた花を見つめるナハトは、何も言わなかったけれど……とても、とてもさ: Nacht hadn't said anything as he stared at the flower resting on his palm, but... he had looked so, so very lonely.
ナハトはソルの前でも、私の前でも、いつも多くを語らない。: Whether in front of Sol or in front of me, Nacht never spoke much.
……そんなナハトが、ソルのことをどう思っていたのか。: Just how had Nacht felt about Sol?
その横顔を見るだけで、小さな私にも良くよくわかった。: Just by looking at his profile, even someone as small as me could understand it all too well.
それがそもそもの間違いだった。: That had been the mistake from the very beginning.
……私が、ソルにとっての死神、だったんだ: "...I was the grim reaper for Sol."
ナハトは私を家に住まわせることを最初は反対していた。あのとき何も言わずに家を出て: Nacht had been against letting me live in their house at first. I should have just left without saying a word back then.
ふたりのことを追いかけて“夜”を出歩いた最初の日。“夜の王”だとかいう“何か”と: On the very first day I wandered out into the "Night" chasing after the two of them, I should have just let myself be eaten by the residents of the "Night" who mistook me for the "King of the Night" or whatever that "something" was.
後悔だ。その数はいくつ数えてもきりがない。: Regrets. No matter how many of them I counted, there was no end to them.
お願い。なんだってする。どんなことだってがまんする。私の全部を、あげるから。だか: "Please. I'll do anything. I'll endure whatever it takes. I'll give you everything I have. So... please. I'm begging you."
どうか、神さま、ナハトに大切なお友だちを返してあげて……。: Please, God, give Nacht back his precious friend...
ざわざわと騒がしい構内の喧噪ばかりが耳につく中で――“覚悟は、あるのかな”と女の: Amidst the noisy bustle of the station echoing in my ears--the girl asked me, "Are you prepared for what it takes?"
応えてほしいと、その子は言った。: She told me she wanted an answer.
あなたは、あなた自身がそのひとにとっての死神だったんだと……そう、言っていたけれ: "You said that you yourself were the grim reaper for that person... You said that, didn't you?"
こんなにも小さくて、こんなにも泣き虫なあなたに……あなたが殺してしまったという怪: "Someone as small and as much of a crybaby as you... bringing back to life the monster you claim to have killed. Do you really have the resolve it takes to do that?"
当然、あると応えた。: Naturally, I answered that I did.
構わないと応えた。: I answered that I didn't mind.
平気だと、応えた。: I answered that I would be fine.
どんなにつらくて、怖くても、私は……: "No matter how painful or scary it is, I..."
お願いだよ。安易にうなずいたりしないでほしい: "Please. I don't want you to nod so easily."
女の子は一度、私の言葉を遮った。: The girl interrupted my words for a moment.
いい？ ちゃんと、しっかり、想像力を働かせてほしいんだ: "Okay? I want you to really, truly use your imagination."
良くよく考えて応えてほしい――つらいこと、怖いこと……悲しいこと。この世にはあり: "I want you to think it through very carefully before answering--painful things, scary things... sad things. This world is overflowing with all sorts of them. It means you're going to need the courage to stand up to them."
ふたりが、ソルが、これから先、私に立ちはだかるだろう困難を、自分の力で解決するた: The two of them--Sol--had told me there was something he wanted me to learn so that I could overcome the hardships that would stand in my way in the future with my own strength.
それは勇気なんだよと私にソルは教えてくれた。いつだって必要なのはそれだけなのだ。: Sol had taught me that this something was courage. That was the only thing I would ever need. And so, I...
もう一度だけ聞くよ。女の子。もう二度と泣かず、強く……あなたの“夢”を叶えられる: "I'll ask you just one more time, little girl. Can you swear that you'll never cry again, that you'll be strong... and that you'll never give up until your 'dream' comes true?"
今、ここで、ソルが学んでほしいと願ってくれた[それ|勇気]を出せなくて、どうする: If I couldn't muster that courage Sol had wished for me to learn right here and now, what would I do?
私はふたりの大切な時間を壊した。: I had destroyed the precious time the two of them shared.
……私は、いないほうがよかった。: It would have been better if I had never existed.
だからせめて、私を育ててくれたふたりが、いつか、自慢に思ってくれる子に私はなりた: So at the very least, I wanted to become a child that the two who raised me could be proud of someday. I had to become that.
もう二度と泣かないし、この願いを叶えるまで……決して諦めない。絶対。絶対。何があ: "I'll never cry again, and until I make this wish come true... I'll never give up. Never. Never ever. No matter what happens... I'll be fine."
女の子はじっと私の目を見つめた――その視線から私は目をそらさず見つめ返していた。: The girl stared straight into my eyes--and I stared right back without looking away from her gaze.
そして小さなその手を私に差し出す――さあ、この手を取って、と。: And then, she held out her tiny hand to me--as if to say, "Come on, take this hand."
何もかもが上手くいけば、“さよなら”をしてしまったひとを取り戻せる……かも、しれ: "If everything goes well, you might... just be able to get back the person you said 'goodbye' to."
もし私がソルを連れて帰ることが叶えば……。: If my wish to bring Sol back home came true...
あのひとは泣き止んでくれるだろうか。笑ってくれるだろうか。: Would he stop crying? Would he smile for me?
だけど……その代わり、あなたのその願いを、夢を、叶えてあげる代わりに……あなたに: "However... in exchange for granting that wish of yours, that dream of yours... there is something I want you to save."
あなたが、あなた[・|達]が、救うのは……: "What you--what all of you--will be saving is..."
女の子は小首をかしげ、ぽつりと、言った。: The girl tilted her head slightly and murmured.
あまりにもあんまりな回答に、私はぽかんとしてしまう――世界？ 世界を、救う？: The answer was so overwhelming that my mind went blank--the world? Save the world?
……すべての命を喰らい尽くすのだと言われてる“夜の王”。[・|そ][・|れ]が出: "...The 'King of the Night,' who is said to devour all life. I've found the place where it is going to appear."
あなたがこの手を取るのなら……これからあなたを、私が、“夜の王”が出現すと推測さ: "If you take this hand... I will take you from here to the point where the 'King of the Night' is predicted to appear."
同じようにして集められたあなた[・|達]には、そこでそれぞれに適した“魔法”を学: "There, I want all of you who have been gathered in the same way to learn the 'magic' suited to each of you, join forces... and defeat it."
そう、だね。この世界と、あなた達人間の未来を守る、そのために: "That's right. In order to protect this world, and the future of you humans."
……で、でも、倒すなんて……そんなこと、どうやって: "...B-But, defeat it... How could I possibly do something like that?"
“夜の王”――私が知っているのは名前だけ。: The "King of the Night"--the only thing I knew about it was its name.
[・|そ][・|れ]がいったい何なのか。[・|そ][・|れ]がどんな姿をしたもの: What on earth it was. What kind of form it took.
何もかも、私は、知らないのに……。: I didn't know a single thing about it, and yet...
この手を取れば、あなたは、この世界を救うための刃となる: "If you take this hand, you will become a blade to save this world."
女の子は、言った――あなたがそう望もうと望むまいとそういうふうになってしまうのだ: The girl spoke--telling me that whether I wished for it or not, that was how it would turn out.
私はこの世界を救う“心の力”を備えた子たちを探してる。きっと、あなたの願いは世界: "I'm looking for children who possess the 'strength of heart' to save this world. Surely, your wish will save the world. I could feel it. Your strong feelings reached me."
心の力とは願いの力だと女の子は言った――その願いの力が“夜の王”と戦うための武器: The girl said that the strength of heart was the power of a wish--and that the power of that wish would become a weapon to fight the "King of the Night."
その願い、あるいは“夢”が、とほうもなく大きなものであればあるだけ……きっと、そ: "The more tremendously huge that wish, or 'dream,' is... surely, that wish, that dream, will become an equally tremendous power."
覚えておいて。あなたの救いの主は私なんかじゃない。あなた自身だよ: "Remember this. Your savior isn't someone like me. It's you yourself."
あなたが自分自身の願いを信じられるのなら。心の強さを、守り続けられると誓うのなら: "If you can believe in your own wish. If you swear that you can keep protecting the strength of your heart--"
あなたの願いを叶えるために……大切なひとを取り戻す、そのために: "To make your wish come true... to take back the person precious to you."
私と一緒に、“夜”の先へと……その最果てへと出かけよう。人生に一度だけの大冒険が: "Let's head out together beyond the 'Night'... to the very ends of it. A once-in-a-lifetime grand adventure is waiting for you."
私は、ほんの僅かに感じた戸惑いを打ち消すように、差し出されたその手を取った。: As if to shake off the slight hesitation I felt, I took the hand she held out to me.
私は、旅に出た。: I set out on a journey.
ソルを取り戻すまでは絶対に帰らないと誓い――: Swearing that I would never return until I got Sol back--
私の手を引く小さな女の子。彼女の友だちなのだという列車に乗った。: A tiny little girl pulling me by the hand. We boarded a train that she said was a friend of hers.
行き先は告げられていない。: I hadn't been told our destination.
これは世界を救うための旅……。: This was a journey to save the world...
これは私が私の願いを叶えるための旅。: This was a journey to make my wish come true.
私が、私のことを信じ続けるための旅。: A journey for me to keep believing in myself.
ただそれだけがこの胸の中にある――: That alone was what filled my heart--
ここにいても、平気なの？: "Is it really okay for you to be sitting here?"
隣に座る女の子に私は言った。旅立ちのときからずっと、寄り添うようにしてくれている: I asked the girl sitting next to me. Ever since we set out on our journey, she had been staying close by my side.
……列車には、私とあなた、ふたりしかいないみたいだけど: "...It looks like you and I are the only two on this train, though."
そう問いかける私に『うん。平気』と女の子はうなずいた。: When I asked her that, the girl nodded and said, "Yeah. It's fine."
この子は賢いからね。むしろ私がとやかく指示を出すより、全部をすっかり任せていたほ: "This kid is smart, after all. Rather than me bossing them around with instructions, things actually go much better when I just leave everything completely up to them."
女の子は顔にズレ落ちてくる大きな帽子を何度も直している。: The girl kept adjusting the large hat that kept slipping down over her face.
餅は餅屋というでしょう。なんだって。どんなことだって。だいたいそういうふうにして: "Leave it to the experts, as they say. With anything. With everything. Things usually work out best when you do it like that. Probably, anyway."
そう言った女の子は、抱えていた鞄の中身をごそごそとしていた。: Saying that, the girl rummaged around inside the bag she was holding.
見れば鞄の中にはいっぱいのお菓子が入ってる。: Looking inside, I saw that the bag was stuffed full of sweets.
いくつかあめ玉をもらった。スナック菓子や色とりどりの甘いゼリーも――こんなものば: She gave me a few pieces of hard candy. There were also snack foods and colorful sweet jellies--do you eat nothing but stuff like this?
そう問いかけると、『うん。そうだよ』と、口の中のあめ玉をころころ舐めながら女の子: When I asked her that, the girl rolled the candy around in her mouth as she licked it and replied, "Yep. That's right."
でもね、うーん……。そろそろお菓子にも飽きちゃって: "Although, hmmm... I'm starting to get a little tired of sweets lately."
何か、私のお口に合う美味しいものを探してるところなんだよ。別に私という“何か”は: "I'm currently on the lookout for something delicious that suits my tastes. Not that a 'something' like me is going to die if I don't eat meals, mind you..."
でも美味しいものを食べたいという気持ちを満たすということは、長いながい暇をつぶす: Still, satisfying the desire to eat delicious food was apparently the perfect pastime for killing a long, long stretch of free time.
甘いの好きだし、お菓子も好きだよ: "I do like sweet things, and I like candy too."
でも今は、お砂糖の甘さより……なんて言うのかな。どちらかというと身体に悪そうな脂: "Right now, though, rather than sugary sweetness... how should I put it? I'm kind of in the mood to try eating something greasy that's probably bad for you."
少しの間その子と話した。: I chatted with the girl for a little while.
そしてふと、会話が途切れるような予感があったから……。: Then, suddenly having a hunch that a lull in our conversation was coming...
……旅は、まだまだ続くの？: "...Is our journey going to continue for much longer?"
……私は果てもなく思える旅路について問う。: I asked about this seemingly endless journey of ours.
もう少しだけ、時間はあるんだね。: So we still had a little bit of time left.
それなら不思議に思う色々を訪ねてみようか――: In that case, maybe I should try asking her about the various things I was curious about--
……“夜の王”を倒すのは、そのために集められるのは、私だけじゃない？: "...Does that mean I'm not the only one being gathered to defeat the 'King of the Night'?"
辿り着いたその先に、あなたと良く似た子たちが集められる――予定だよ: "Once we reach our destination, children very much like you will be gathered there--that's the plan, anyway."
たったひとりで“困難”に立ち向かうのはさみしくて、未知なる“何か”を学ぶには、や: "Standing up to 'hardships' all on your own is lonely, and when it comes to learning about an unknown 'something,' there are just way too many tough things to deal with by yourself."
だから共に戦い、共に学べる仲間を私が連れてくるよと女の子。: That was why, the girl said, she would bring companions who could fight and learn alongside me.
できうることなら、その子らと……[・|あ][・|の][・|子]と、仲良くしてあげ: "If at all possible, I'd really like you to get along with those kids... with that girl."
[・|そ][・|こ]には何人くらい、集められる予定なの？: "About how many people are supposed to be gathered there?"
またいじめられたりしないだろうか。: Would I end up getting bullied again?
……もしも意地悪な子がいたら。: What if there were mean kids there?
……今度こそひとりぼっちで立ち向かわなきゃ行けない。: Then I really would have to face everything all alone this time.
あなた達を受け入れる先の主が、もうこれ以上は無理かな、って。そう言い出すくらいは: "I'm thinking of gathering enough that the master of the place taking you all in will say, 'I don't think I can handle any more than this.'"
たぶん四、五人くらいかな、と女の子は言った。: Probably around four or five people, the girl said.
未来に対する恐怖だって[・|い][・|つ][・|も][・|以][・|上]につきま: Even my fear of the future was clinging to me more than usual, and yet...
……ナハト。今、どうしてるかな。: Nacht. I wonder how he's doing right now.
私がいなくなっていることに気づいたら……ほっとするだろうか。: When he realizes I'm gone... will he feel relieved?
無理矢理微笑みを作り、私はそう問いかけてみた。: Forcing a smile onto my face, I tried asking her that.
女の子は首を振り、言った。三つ編みの長い髪がふわりと揺れる。: The girl shook her head and spoke, her long braided hair swaying softly.
言ったと思うけど、私は私が何なのかわからない。私はただ、ここにいるだけの“何か”: "I think I mentioned this before, but I don't know what I am. I'm just a 'something' that happens to be here... so a name? I don't have anything like that. Even if I did, there's no one to call me by it anyway."
それは、さみしいねと私は言った。: That sounds lonely, I told her.
だけどそれもそれで慣れてしまえば平気だよとも。: Though she also added that once you get used to it, it's really no big deal.
孤独っていうのはさ、きっと上手に、丁寧に、慎重に付き合えば、最高のお友だちになれ: "I think loneliness is a 'something' that can become your absolute best friend, as long as you deal with it skillfully, carefully, and cautiously."
……私はそんなふうに強くなれるだろうか。: Could I ever become as strong as her?
そんな願いを込めたつもりで、私は言った。: Hoping to put that wish into my words, I spoke.
私も、あなたと同じだったよ: "I used to be the same as you."
私も私が誰なのか、いったい何者なのかわからず、お屋敷の中にずっと閉じ込められてい: I didn't know who or what I was either, locked away inside that mansion all that time.
そんな私に名前をくれた“夜の怪物”: It was the "monsters of the Night" who gave a name to someone like me.
ふたりに“千和”と呼ばれるそれだけで、私は誰でもない私から、ふたりに大切に育てて: Just by having the two of them call me "Chiwa," I went from being a nobody to a child they raised with love and care.
それはたった一年の間だけだったけれど……。: Even if it was only for a single year...
三人で暮らした時間は、私にとって大切にしたい宝物だった。: The time the three of us spent living together was a treasure I wanted to cherish forever.
これからどんな悲しいことがあっても、苦しいことがあったとしても、心の中であの頃の: No matter what sad or painful things might await me from here on out, as long as I held the memories of those days in my heart, I could keep going--I would surely be able to tell myself that I had to push through, even if I had to force myself.
もう泣かないと決めたのに、三人で笑っていた今夜のことを思うと……。: I had already decided I wouldn't cry anymore, and yet, when I thought back to tonight, when the three of us were laughing together...
たった数時間前のことを思うと、涙がまた流れそうになり……。: Just thinking about what happened mere hours ago made the tears threaten to spill over all over again...
必ず私がソルを連れて帰るから……。: I'll definitely bring Sol back home...
……女の子のそんな言葉にハッとして、私は涙を袖で乱暴に拭った。: Startled by the girl's words, I roughly wiped my tears away with my sleeve.
ここが、“夜の王”が現れるとされている[ポイント|場所]だよ: "This is the point where the 'King of the Night' is said to appear."
そしてあなたが、あなた自身の願いを叶える――そのための“魔法”を得る場所でもある: "And it's also the place where you'll obtain the 'magic' you need--to make your own wish come true."
大きな汽笛に身体を震わせ――……停車。: A loud whistle made my body tremble--...and the train came to a halt.
そこは私たちの暮らしていた町、“参禅町”の駅だった。: It was the station of the town where we had been living, "Sanzen Town."
しかもさっき出発したばかりの“夜”の中。“刻の終着駅”だ。: Not only that, we were inside the "Night," at the very place we had just departed from: "Time's Terminal Station."
何かの間違えだろうか。: Could this be some kind of mistake?
そう思い、構内に降りた私は振り返る。: Thinking that, I turned around where I stood on the platform.
女の子も着いてきてくれていると思ってた。: I had assumed the girl was following right behind me.
……ごめんね。ここから先は一緒に行けない: "...I'm sorry. I can't go with you any further than this."
だけど女の子は開かれた扉の側――列車の中に立っていた。: However, the girl was standing inside the train, right beside the open doors.
私にはあまり自由がないんだよ: "I don't have very much freedom, you see."
女の子はさみしそうに、言う。: The girl spoke with a lonely look on her face.
私は“夜”の中でもごく限られた場所でしか出歩けないようになっている。どういうわけ: "Even within the 'Night,' I'm only able to walk around in a very limited number of places. For whatever reason, that's just how it is."
この列車の中。この駅の中。この町にあるという神社の敷地内。: Inside this train. Inside this station. And on the grounds of a shrine said to be in this town.
それが女の子が唯一、出歩ける場所なのだと言う――あなたと私は同じだねと言ったけれ: She told me those were the only places she could walk around--I had said earlier that she and I were the same, but I was wrong. This girl had far, far less freedom than I ever did.
良くよく聞いて。思いの外早く到着してしまったからあまり多くを説明する暇がなかった: "Listen very carefully. We arrived sooner than I expected, so I didn't have time to explain very much. I feel bad keeping it so brief, but I'm going to pass the bare minimum of information you need on to you right now."
私はうなずき……女の子の声をけして聞き漏らすまいとした。: I nodded... determined not to miss a single word she said.
……突拍子もないことを言うようだけれど……、ごめんね: "...This might sound completely outlandish, so... I'm sorry in advance."
あなたが暮らしていた“[町|参禅町]”のように見えて、そうではない――……[・|: "It might look like the 'Sanzen Town' you lived in, but it isn't--...This is a world of the future, lying beyond a long, long leap through time from back then."

私たちのお家にやって来たばっかりの頃の小さな大雅が、なんだか、さみしがりな子に見: "When you had just come to our house, back when you were little, you looked like a lonely kid somehow--"
だから、私。仕方なくお話ししてあげてるだけなんだよ。別に私は、この妹は、大雅のこ: "So I'm just talking to you out of pity. It's not like I--this little sister of yours--like you at all, Taiga."
俺はパッと、繋いでいた手を離す。: I quickly let go of the hand I was holding.
そんなこと言う子とはもう手を繋いであげないんだからな: "I'm not holding hands with a girl who says things like that anymore."
お風呂にだって一緒に入ってあげないし、一緒にご飯を食べたりもしてあげないぞ。膝の: "I won't take baths with you, and I won't eat meals with you either. I won't even let you sit on my lap."
いいもんいいもん。十夜が意地悪するから、大雅くんはふて腐れてしまうことに決めまし: "Fine, fine. Since you're being mean, Toya, Taiga-kun has decided to sulk."
十夜が“大雅大好き”って言ってくれるまで、大雅くんはもう二度と、十夜とはお手て繋: "Until you say 'I love you, Taiga,' Taiga-kun is never holding hands and walking with you ever again, Toya."
しかし十夜は、すっごいさみしそうな顔をして俺を見上げ……。: However, Toya looked up at me with an incredibly lonely expression on her face...
しょんぼりしていた。泣きそうでもあった。: She looked crestfallen. She even looked like she was about to cry.
なんだか、罪悪感が。: Somehow, I felt a pang of guilt.
苦笑いで『嘘だよ泣いちゃだめだよ』ともう一度手を繋ぐ。: With a wry smile, I told her, "I was just kidding, don't cry," and took her hand once more.
ぐずぐずと十夜は小さな鼻をすすっていた。: Toya sniffled with her tiny nose.
この時間の中で夢見るためにではない。: Not to dream within this time.
悪戯に想像力を働かせ、“夜”の中を誰より早く駆け抜けて、“夜の王”――その模造品: Nor was it to take part in a grand dream of letting our imaginations run wild, racing through the "Night" faster than anyone else to strike down that counterfeit "King of the Night."
十夜の握りしめた鍵を役立てるために……俺たちは、進んだ。: In order to put the key clutched tightly in Toya's hand to use... we pressed onward.
十夜のお友だちの家。その玄関先だ。: The front door of Toya's friend's house.
この前やって来たときは、ここで“勇気がないから……”と引き返したけれど。: The last time we came here, she had turned back right at this spot, saying she didn't have the courage...
大雅とお姉ちゃんに、お友だちのこと聞いてもらったら……なんだかちょっと、ちょっと: "Having you and Big Sis listen to me talk about my friend... made me feel like I could muster up a little, just a little bit of courage."
十夜の手には“鍵”がある。小さな“鍵”だ。: There was a "key" in Toya's hand. A small "key."
銀色。その柄には雨降りの空が彫刻されていた。: It was silver, with a rainy sky carved into its bow.
……それは、俺が“夜の国”や“ゆめのねどこ”に立ち入るために、かつてあさひさんか: You could say it was the exact same kind of thing Asahi-san had once handed to me so I could enter the "Country of Night" and the "Dream Bed."
今、十夜の手のひらに握られている鍵は――十夜のお友だちが“夜”と繋がるためのもの: The key currently clutched in Toya's palm was meant to connect her friend with the "Night."
“夜”の住人である十夜が、そのお友だちとの間に築けた“関係性”: The "relationship" Toya, a resident of the "Night," had managed to build with her friend.
それが形になったもの。: This was that bond given form.
十夜が扉の鍵穴に“[魔法|鍵]”を差し込む。: Toya inserted the "magic key" into the door's keyhole.
そして“鍵”を回した。そっと、回した。: And then she turned the "key." Gently, she turned it.
閉ざされた扉が開かれる音。: The sound of a closed door opening.
安堵の声色だった。: Her voice was filled with relief.
この扉が開いたということは……、: The fact that this door opened meant...
“自分だけがあの子のお友だちだと思っていたらどうしよう”: 'What if I'm the only one who thought of her as a friend?'
……そんな十夜の不安は、ひとまず解決されたことになる。: That anxiety of Toya's was resolved for the time being.
どちらか片方だけが“お友だち”だと思っているだけではだめだ。: It wouldn't work if only one side thought of the other as a "friend."
それでは“関係性”は成立しない。心の扉を開くための“魔法”は成り立たない。: A "relationship" cannot be established that way. The "magic" to open the door to someone's heart wouldn't take hold.
もしも扉が開かなければ、また引き返さなければならなかった。: If the door hadn't opened, we would have had to turn back again.
……おそらくはこれまで以上に悲しい気持ちになっていただろう十夜と一緒に。: And I would have been walking back with a Toya who was likely even sadder than before.
だが、大丈夫。扉は開く。: But it was okay. The door would open.
さあ、行こうか。十夜の“夢”を叶えに行こう: "Come on, let's go. Let's go make your 'dream' come true, Toya."
そしてふたり一緒に扉のノブを握りしめた。: Together, the two of us gripped the doorknob tightly.
……ここから先は十夜の“夢”を叶えるための時間となる。: From here on out, it would be time to fulfill Toya's "dream."
十夜は俺の隣で、小さくぶつぶつとつぶやいていた。: Beside me, Toya was muttering quietly under her breath.
扉の向こうのお友だちに伝えたい言葉たち。: The words she wanted to convey to her friend on the other side of the door.
お友だちと会えるのはおそらく今夜限りだろう――人間の女の子は成長がとても早いのだ: Tonight would likely be the very last time she could meet her friend--human girls grow up so fast. Both in heart and in body.
だからちゃんと気持ちや言葉を取りこぼすことなく口にできるようにと練習していた。: That was why she was practicing, so she could voice her feelings and words properly without leaving anything out.
……うん。大丈夫。もう行ける: "...Yeah. I'm okay. I'm ready to go."
面と向かって直接伝えるのはとっても勇気が要ることだろうと、俺は想像してしまうから: Because I could easily imagine how much courage it must take to say those things directly, face-to-face...
十夜の勇気。この扉の向こうにある時間の、その全部。ちゃんとそばで見てるからね: "Your courage. Everything that happens in the time beyond this door. I'll be right there beside you, watching all of it."
そう言う俺に、照れくさそうに微笑む十夜だ。: Hearing me say that, Toya gave a shy smile.
そして小さくうなずきあって……。: Then we gave each other a small nod...
俺たちは、その扉を一緒に開いた。: And together, we opened the door.
その先に広がった光景は、見知らぬ誰かの家の中――ではない。: The scene that spread out beyond it was not the inside of some stranger's house.
どころか“夜”でさえもなかった。: In fact, it wasn't even the "Night."
太陽の時間。参禅町。その町外れ。: The time of the sun. Sanzen Town. On its outskirts.
……公園だ。隅に建てられた雨よけの小屋のような建物。: A park. A small, shed-like shelter from the rain built in the corner.
女の子はひとりぼっちで空を見ていた。: The girl was looking up at the sky all by herself.
雨雲などひとつもない空からしとしとしとしと雨が降るのだ。: Rain was falling gently and steadily from a sky without a single raincloud in sight.
青空は、しかし、その大気がまるで固いガラスのように所々がひび割れていて……。: However, the atmosphere of the blue sky was cracked in places, just like hard glass...
その隙間からきらきら光る星空が覗いていた。: And through those gaps, a sparkling starry sky peeked out.
宇宙だ。銀河だ。見たこともない星空と星座たち。: Space. The galaxy. A starry sky and constellations I had never seen before.
そんな空の隙間からこぼれ落ちた流れ星。地上にいくつもいくつも降り注ぐ。: Shooting stars spilled out from the gaps in the sky, raining down upon the ground in countless numbers.
雨粒と思ったものは全部、小さなちいさな星の光だ。: Everything I had thought were raindrops were actually tiny, minuscule fragments of starlight.
降り注ぐ固い道路などでパチンと弾けて消えていく。: They rained down, popping and vanishing against the hard road.
バス停のベンチに座り、雨降りの――星降る空を見上げてる――あの子の夢の、その中だ: We were inside the dream of that girl sitting on the bus stop bench, looking up at the rainy--the star-falling--sky.
女の子はひとりぼっちで、夢のような空を見ている。: The girl was watching the dreamlike sky all alone.
……さみしそうに。悲しそうに。たった、ひとりで。: Looking so lonely. So sad. All by herself.
頬をすべり、落ちていき……。: It slid down her cheek, falling...
握りしめた手の甲で弾けてしまう。: And burst against the back of her tightly clenched hand.
そんな一滴の中には、あの子の“悲しい”“さみしい”そんな気持ちがたくさん詰まって: That single drop looked as though it were packed full of her "sad" and "lonely" feelings.
夢の中でさえひとりぼっちで涙を流す女の子。: A girl shedding tears all alone, even within a dream.
あの子はまだ心にさみしい気持ちを残してる。: That girl still had lonely feelings lingering in her heart.
その心のどこかに“悪夢”が住んでる。そしてあの子の心で暴れてる。: A "Nightmare" was living somewhere inside her heart. And it was rampaging within her.
だからあんなに悲しそうで、さみしそう。ひとりぼっちで泣いている。: That was why she looked so sad and lonely, crying all by herself.
十夜は女の子のところに駆けていく。: Toya ran over to the girl.
そして俺はあの“ぬいぐるみ”のことを思い出していた。: Meanwhile, I was remembering that "stuffed animal."
あのときの“悪夢”は、持ち主の心の中を抜け出して――: The "Nightmare" back then had slipped out of its owner's heart--
“夜”の中をまるで迷子のようにさ迷っていた。: And was wandering through the "Night" just like a lost child.
この夢の世界のどこかに“悪夢”が隠れているかもしれない: "There might be a 'Nightmare' hiding somewhere in this dream world."
またあの“ぬいぐるみ”のときのように、自分自身を傷つけ暴れる“悪夢”を相手に、乱: Just like back then with that "stuffed animal," we might have to resort to rough measures against a rampaging "Nightmare" that was hurting itself.
そのための覚悟は決めておこう。: I needed to prepare myself for that.
心に“[魔法|想像力]”は充分だろうか。: Did I have enough "magic"--enough imagination--in my heart?
そんなことを思いながら、俺も十夜の後を追う。: Thinking about these things, I followed after Toya.
ちょうど十夜がお友だちの女の子に声をかけているところだった。: Toya was just calling out to the girl, her friend.
十夜は涙を流す女の子の手を握った。: Toya took the crying girl's hand.
どうしてあなたはいつも、ひとりぼっちで泣いてたの？: "Why were you always crying all by yourself?"
……何かつらいことがあるなら教えて欲しい。: If something is hurting you, I want you to tell me.
あなたを悲しくさせてる悪い夢が、まだまだ消えずに、心のどこかにあるのなら――……: If a bad dream that's making you sad hasn't gone away yet, and is still somewhere inside your heart--...I want to return it to the "Night."
子どもの頃に抱えたつらい気持ちをそのままに、大人になってしまうと悲しいことが多い: "If you grow up while still holding onto the painful feelings you had as a child, there will be so much sadness waiting for you..."
だからそんな心をあなたの中から連れ去りたい。: That's why I want to take that heartache away from inside you.
あなたがどんなにつらくても。悲しくても。今夜からはきっと、大丈夫になる。私のお友: "No matter how painful it is for you. No matter how sad you are. Starting tonight, you'll definitely be okay. Because my friend. Because Taiga. He'll definitely defeat your painful feelings... your bad dream."
そのためには何があったのかを教えてもらわなければならない。: For that to happen, we needed her to tell us what had occurred.
そうでなければ、心のどこに、夢の世界のどこに、“悪夢”が隠れているのかを見つけ出: Otherwise, we wouldn't be able to find out where in her heart, or where in this dream world, the "Nightmare" was hiding...
だからお願い。話してほしい: "So please. I want you to talk to me."
ごめんね。嫌なことをわざわざ思い出させるなんて。そんなの。お友だち失格だけど: "I'm sorry. Making you remember unpleasant things on purpose like this... It makes me a terrible friend, doesn't it?"
……でも、それでいい。それで嫌われたって構わない: "...Even so, that's fine. I don't care if you hate me for it."
それであなたが、明日から、幸せに生きていけるなら……: "If it means that starting tomorrow, you can live happily..."
もうあなたが、さみしくなくなるのなら……。私は: "If it means you won't be lonely anymore... Then I..."
うつむく十夜をじっと見つめていた。: She was staring intently at Toya, who was looking down.
ふたりのことを背後から見ている俺は……。: Watching the two of them from behind, I...
十夜をじっと見つめる女の子の様子に、警戒してしまっている。: I found myself on guard at the way the girl was staring so fixedly at Toya.
今、目の前に座るこの子自身が、この子の“悪夢”の姿なのではないか――: Could it be that this girl sitting right in front of us is the form of her own "Nightmare"--?
そのような感情が頭の中に広がっていたからだ。: Because that sort of feeling was spreading through my mind.
十夜のことをじっと見つめたまま――こう、言った。: Still staring intently at Toya--she said this.
“[・|ど][・|う][・|し][・|て][・|あ][・|な][・|た][・|は: "Why have you always looked so lonely?"
そして女の子は小さく笑った。: Then the girl gave a small smile.
十夜の手を握り返して、女の子は言うのだ。: Squeezing Toya's hand back, the girl spoke.
“さみしがり屋の不思議な子。私は、[・|私][・|た][・|ち][・|は]、あな: "You lonely, mysterious girl. I--we--don't want to leave you all alone."
“本当は、いつまでもずっと一緒にいたいけど……”: "Truthfully, I want to stay together with you forever and ever..."
“でも、もう、[・|噂][・|ど][・|お][・|り]、さよならしないといけない: "But if, just like the rumors say, we have to say goodbye now... If that is what our relationship is. Then please."
お願いします、と女の子はまた涙を見せた。: "Please," the girl said, showing tears once more.
“最後に私の夢を、あなたに……魔法のような、奇跡のような、小さなあなたに……聞い: "At the very end, I want you... someone small, like magic, like a miracle... to hear my dream."
そう言うと女の子は[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。: Saying that, the girl closed her eyelids.
こぼれる涙を閉じ込めるみたいにして。: As if trying to lock away the spilling tears.
“[・|大][・|切][・|な][・|あ][・|の][・|人][・|の][・|夢: "I want to grant the dream of that person who is so precious to me..."
“私の悪夢は、そこに、あるんだよ”: "My nightmare is right there, you see."
雨降りの公園でひとり泣いていたらそんな声が聞こえた。: When I was crying all alone in the rainy park, I heard a voice.
顔を上げると、女の子がひとり。: When I looked up, there was a single girl.
その子が繰り返し私にこう問いかけた――……大丈夫？ どこか、痛いの？: She asked me this over and over--...Are you okay? Does it hurt somewhere?
名前も知らない女の子に私はうなずく。: I nodded to the girl whose name I didn't even know.
ちょっとだけ、胸のあたりがずきずきして、痛いの: "Right around my chest, it's throbbing and hurting just a little."
そんな言葉をこぼすと……だめだ。: When I let those words spill out... it was no good.
心に自分の言葉が突き刺さり――小さなちいさな穴があく。: My own words pierced my heart--opening a tiny, tiny hole.
そこから次々と“つらかったこと”が涙となってこぼれて落ちた。: From there, all the "painful things" spilled out one after another as tears and fell.
気づけばその子に話していた。: Before I knew it, I was talking to her.
クラスメイトから。先生から。: By my classmates. By my teacher.
誰からも愛されない自分。鈍くさい自分。そんな自分のことを大嫌いな、自分。: A me who isn't loved by anyone. A clumsy me. A me who hates that version of myself.
学校に私の居場所なんてどこにもなかった。: There wasn't a place where I belonged anywhere at school.
自分自身の中にさえ、大嫌いな自分の居場所を認められなかった――: Even within myself, I couldn't accept a place for this me that I hated so much--
そんなのはもはやよくある話だ。: A story like that is all too common by now.
全国どこの学校にでも必ずひとつやふたつあるだろうし、大人の世界にだってそれはきっ: There's bound to be one or two cases like it in every school across the country, and surely it exists in the adult world, too.
自分のことを好きだと言い切れる人間だって、さほど多くもないはずだ。: There probably aren't that many people who can say for sure that they like themselves, either.
この世界は子どもも大人もつらいことだらけ。: This world is full of painful things for both children and adults.
そしてその中でも、いじめなんてものはもう“つらいこと”の常套句のようなものだろう: And among all of that, something like bullying is practically a cliche when it comes to "painful things."
そこには目新しさもなければ、“私だってそれくらい何度も経験しているぞ”と鼻で笑わ: There's nothing new about it; it's such a common story that people would just scoff and say, "Even I've experienced that much plenty of times."
だからそれくらいで泣いてるなんて――甘えちゃだめだ。: So crying over something like that--I mustn't be so spoiled.
あなた以外の誰もがみんな、毎日懸命に、頑張っている。: Everyone else besides you is trying their absolute hardest every single day.
そんなふうに呆れられるのが怖いから。: Because I was afraid of people being disgusted with me like that.
そんなふうに怒られてしまうのが悲しいから。: Because it would make me sad to be scolded like that.
だからこうして、誰もいない雨降りの公園で泣いていたのに……。: That was why I had been crying in a rainy park with no one around, and yet...
つらそうに。悲しそうに。さみしそうに。: Looking pained. Looking sad. Looking lonely.
私なんかのよくある話を、まるで自分のことのように、聞いていた。: She was listening to a common story from someone like me as if it were happening to her.
この世界にはね、たくさんの“魔法”が、あるんだよ: "There is lots and lots of 'magic' in this world, you know."
その子は言った。泣いてばかりの私の心を撫でるみたいに。: The girl said that. As if gently stroking my heart, which had done nothing but cry.
……悲しいことがちょっとだけ軽くなる“魔法”を、私、知ってるよ。それを一緒に試し: "...I know a 'magic' spell that makes sad things just a little bit lighter. I'd like for us to try it together."
うん、そうだよと言って、その子はうなずく。: "Yeah, that's right," the girl said, nodding.
つらいときとか、悲しいときとか。そういうときはね、なんだか身体の内側が重たくなる: "When you're hurting, or when you're sad. At times like that, doesn't it kind of feel like the inside of your body gets heavy...?"
そんなときはね。つらい、悲しい、とってもさみしい……そんな気持ちが身体とか、心の: "At times like that, you see. Painful, sad, and very lonely feelings... they're packed so, so tightly inside your body and inside your heart."
だからね。そんなつらい気持ちを言葉にして、身体の外に出してあげられれば……: "So, you see. If you can put those painful feelings into words and let them out of your body..."
そしたら少し、ほんの少しだけかもしれないけれど、身体の重さが軽くなって……たくさ: "Then a little, even if it's just a tiny bit, the heaviness in your body will get lighter... and you'll become 'okay' a whole lot--that's what my big sister told me."
そう。それはきっとね、誰もが使える“魔法”のひとつ……なんだよって: "Yes. She said that it's surely one of the kinds of 'magic' that anyone can use..."
私の大好きなお姉ちゃんは“魔法使い”なの。他にもたくさんの“魔法”を知ってるよ: "My beloved big sister is a 'magician.' She knows lots of other 'magic' spells, too."
だから、そんなお姉ちゃんに教えてもらった“魔法”のひとつを試してみたいのと、女の: That was why she wanted to try out one of the "magic" spells her big sister had taught her, the girl said.
この“魔法”はね、聞いてくれる人と話してくれる人が必要で、ひとりぼっちじゃできな: "You see, this 'magic' needs someone to listen and someone to talk, so it's a 'magic' spell you can't do all by yourself..."
この“魔法”を覚えて、いつかお姉ちゃんみたいな“魔法使い”になりたい私に、協力し: "I want to learn this 'magic' and become a 'magician' like my big sister someday, so if you'd help me out... it would make me really happy."
笑顔でそう言う女の子。: The girl said that with a smile.
だけどその表情はどこか震えているようにも見えたのだ。: However, her expression looked as though it were trembling slightly.
たぶんこの子は私と同じだ。: Maybe this girl is the same as me.
……私と同じ、内気な子。: A shy girl, just like me.
ほんとはこんなふうに、知らない[私|誰か]に平気で話しかけられるような子ではない: Truthfully, she wasn't the kind of girl who could casually strike up a conversation with a complete stranger like me.
でも、私のために無理をして、がんばって、話してくれてる――: Yet for my sake, she was pushing herself, trying her hardest to talk to me--
[わけ|理由]もなくそう感じ取ることができたから。: For no particular reason, I could sense that.
だから私も、話すことにした。その子の“魔法”を試してみることにした。: So I decided to talk, too. I decided to try out her "magic."
……クラスのとある子に目を付けられたの。みんなその子の言いなり: "...A certain kid in my class singled me out. Everyone does whatever they say."
皆がみんなその子に嫌われたくないからと、言われるままに私にだけ嫌なことをする。: Because none of them wanted to be disliked by that kid, they did as they were told and did awful things only to me.
クラスメイトだけじゃない。先生も一緒になって。: Not just my classmates. My teacher joined in, too.
大人のことを上手に、思うように、操るようにできてしまう――“[・|要][・|領]: Kids who know how to play the game--who can skillfully manipulate adults into doing whatever they want--aren't all that rare.
地獄だ。毎日がただの地獄の底だった。: It's hell. Every day was nothing short of the depths of hell.

これからはお母さんがそばにいてくれる。私の味方でいてくれる――“夢”は、叶った。: Because from now on, Mom will be by my side. She'll be on my side--my "dream" came true.
でも、ひとつだけ、この町でやり残したことがある。: However, there was just one thing I had left unfinished in this town.
ここにあの子を残して行くのがどうしても気がかりだった。: I couldn't help feeling worried about leaving her behind in this place.
雨の日にしか出会えない私の友だち。: My friend whom I could only meet on rainy days.
……いつもひとりぼっちな、さみしそうな女の子。: That lonely-looking girl who was always all by herself.
あの子の教えてくれた“魔法”が、私の“夢”を叶えてくれたんだと信じたい……。: I wanted to believe that the "magic" she taught me was what made my "dream" come true...
だから今度は私が、あの子だけではない……誰か、たくさんの誰かの“夢”を叶えられる: So this time, I wanted to become someone who could grant the "dreams" of not just her... but of someone else, of many other people.
そう願い、祈ったが故の約束だった――“晴れた日にふたり一緒で公園を出てお出かけし: Our promise was born from that wish, that prayer--"If the two of us leave the park and go out together on a sunny day, it'll surely be fun."
だって、そんな世界はきらきら輝いているように感じられたのだ。: Because a world like that felt as though it would shine and sparkle.
そうして思い描いた未来の光景は、まるで大切な“魔法”みたいに、私の中に笑顔によく: Because the vision of the future I pictured in my mind brought a feeling much like a smile into my heart, just like precious "magic."
世界にきらきら光る涙ばかりが降り注ぐ。: Nothing but sparkling tears continued to pour down upon the world.
さくらの花は静かに散り行き……。: The cherry blossoms quietly scattered away...
さよならの日が、迫る。: And the day of our goodbye drew near.
あの子と会えない日が続いていた。: Days went by without me being able to see her.
雨の日に公園に行ってみてもあの子はいない。どこにも、いない。: Even when I went to the park on rainy days, she wasn't there. She was nowhere to be found.
たぶんあの子も[約束の日|晴れの日]を待っているんだと――私は、信じる。: Maybe she's waiting for the promised sunny day, too--that's what I believed.
ねえ。あなたも一緒に町を出ない？ 新しい私のお家でずっと暮らそう。: Hey. Why don't you leave town with me? Let's live together forever at my new house.
一緒に遊ぶ“約束”をした日に、そう誘っていた。: I had invited her to do just that on the day we made our "promise" to play together.
そうしたらいつでも一緒に遊べるよ。ずっとずっとお友だちでいられるよ、と。: Telling her that if she did, we could play together anytime, and be friends forever and ever.
それは私の心が、どこかであの子はふつうの子とは違うと気づいていたからだろうと思う: I think it was because somewhere deep down, my heart had realized she was different from normal kids.
一度この子と離れ離れになってしまったら、もう二度と私たちは会えなくなると、どこか: I think it was because some part of me had a premonition that once we were separated, we would never be able to see each other again.
あの子が微笑みながらつぶやいた言葉が蘇る。: The words she had murmured with a smile came back to me.

あの子は微笑んだまま、小首をかしげるようにした。: Still smiling, she gave a slight tilt of her head.

『私だけが、いつまでもずっと、忘れられないままでいるけれど……』: "While I'm the only one left never being able to forget, forever and ever..."
『そんな私なんかに、こんな“お誘い”や“約束”をしてくれたのは、あなたが……はじ: "You're... the very first person to ever give someone like me an 'invitation' or a 'promise' like this. That alone makes me feel like my 'dream' has come true. So I'm really, truly happy."
『でもね。きっと、ね……ごめんね。あなたはやっぱり、全部忘れてしまうよ』: "But you know. I'm sure... I'm sorry. In the end, you're going to forget all of it, too."
あの子のさみしい色の微笑みは、ずきりと私の胸に突き刺さる。: Her lonely-looking smile pierced sharply into my chest.
『あなたのことを信じていないわけじゃない。ここで出会えたあなた達全員のことも同じ: "It's not that I don't believe in you. It's the same for all of you whom I've met here. You were all easily hurt, which made you very kind people. It's just..."

変わらず少しさみしそうな笑顔で私を見つめ――“忘れてしまおうよ”と、そう言った。: Gazing at me with that same slightly lonely smile--she told me, "Let's just forget."
『……今日までのことは全部ぜんぶ、綺麗に、さっぱり、忘れてしまえばそれでいい』: "...It's fine if you just cleanly and completely forget every single thing that happened up until today."
『人はみんな、つらいことを忘れることで生きていけるようになるイキモノなんだって、: "My big sister told me that all humans are creatures who manage to keep living by forgetting painful things, and that living that way is what allows them to find happiness."
『だからね。悲しそうだった女の子。今はもう、うれしそうな顔の、女の子』: "So, you know. Little girl who used to look so sad. Little girl who now has such a happy look on her face."
『つらかった気持ちも言葉も、そして記憶も……全部ここに、この時間の中に置いて行け: "If you can leave all your painful feelings, words, and even memories... right here, inside this time... then that's enough. Because that's the whole reason I'm always here like this."
だからお願い、私のことなんて気にしないでね、とあの子は言う。: So please, don't worry about me at all, she said.
『……だけどね。私の大切なお友だち。もしも全部忘れてしまっても、お願いね、悲しい: "...Still, you know. My precious friend. Even if you do end up forgetting everything, please, just don't let yourself feel sad."
『私のことなんてこれっぽっちも気にしないで……お願い。幸せに、生きてね』: "Don't worry about me the tiniest bit... Please. Live a happy life, okay?"
『私は、ここからあなたのことをずっと応援してるから』: "Because I'll always be cheering you on from right here."
『ずっとここで、ずっと、ここから……ねえ、うれしそうな顔の女の子。[・|忘][・: "Always right here, always from right here... Hey, happy-looking girl. *Don't forget, okay?* I'll always be praying... that there is happy 'magic' right by your side."
そんな大人びたことを口にするあの子は――: After saying something so grown-up, she--
『え、えへへ。お姉ちゃん[・|た][・|ち]の決めぜりふを真似てみたの』: "E-Ehehe. I tried copying my big sisters' catchphrase."
どうかな、格好いいかなと、幼い笑顔を見せてくれていた。: She showed me a childish smile, asking if I thought she sounded cool.
私はお姉ちゃんみたいな“魔法使い”になれるかな、と。: Wondering aloud if she could become a "magician" like her big sister.
他の子たちがどうだったのかは知らないけれど……。: I don't know how it was for the other kids...
この世界が、この時間が、どんな規則に縛られているのかなんて、理解もできないけれど: And I can't even begin to understand what kind of rules bind this world, or this time...
私は絶対に、あなたのことを忘れたりしない。: But I will never, ever forget about you.
あなたと出会えて私の中の雨は止み……。: Meeting you made the rain inside me stop...
真っ暗闇の“夜”の中に、たくさん、たくさん、きらきら光る星を見つけたような気がし: And I feel like I've found so, so many sparkling stars within the pitch-black "night."
そして“夢”が叶った。[・|新][・|し][・|い]“[・|夢]”[・|も][・: And my "dream" came true. *I was even able to find a new "dream."*
こんなすてきな出会いを忘れられるはずがない。: There is no way I could ever forget such a wonderful encounter.
今度は晴れた日に、ここで待ち合わせしようねと――約束、したんだ。: We made a promise--that next time, on a sunny day, we would meet up right here.
早く晴れの日が、来ないかなあ。: I wonder if a sunny day will come soon.
ふたりで手と手をつないで、空を見上げる――……: The two of us holding hands, looking up at the sky--...
私たちは“約束”を果たせる日をじっと待っていた。: We waited patiently for the day we could fulfill our "promise."
公園に来ていた。雨降りの公園だ。: I had come to the park. A rainy park.
屋根付きの休憩所で雨宿り。: Taking shelter from the rain under the roofed rest area.
ひとりぼっちで空を見上げた。: All alone, I looked up at the sky.
眠れない夜がずっと続いた。: Sleepless nights dragged on and on.
ひとりぼっちで過ごす夜の時間がつらかった。: The nighttime hours I spent all alone were painful.
すると、足が自然とここに向いたのだ。: And so, my feet naturally led me here.
私の“夢”は学校の先生になることだった。それが私の新しい“夢”: My "dream" was to become a schoolteacher. That was my new "dream."
いつかの私みたいに、悲しい思いをしている子をひとりにさせない。絶対に、させない。: I wouldn't let children who were feeling sad end up all alone, like I once was. I would never let that happen.
その“夢”を叶えるためにたくさん勉強をした。: I studied hard to make that "dream" come true.
いじめられていたことがつらくって、余裕がなくて……。: Being bullied had been so painful, leaving me with no room to breathe...
あの頃は遅れ気味だった勉強も、次第次第に得意になった。: Even my studies, which I had fallen behind on back then, gradually became my strong suit.
結婚する前は先生だったお母さんがつきっきりで教えてくれたから――ふたりでがんばる: Because my mother, who had been a teacher before getting married, stayed right by my side to tutor me--I'm sure I truly loved that time we spent working hard together.
そんな瞬間がめぐって来る度に、私はお母さんと一緒に泣いて、一緒に笑って、一緒に怒: Every time such moments came around, my mother and I cried together, laughed together, got angry together...
そんなたくさんの時間を経て、私は“新しい夢”を叶えられた。: After spending so much time like that, I was able to make my "new dream" come true.
小学校の先生として一生懸命働いた。: I worked as hard as I could as an elementary school teacher.
子どもたちみんなが笑顔になれる方法をいつもいつでも探してた。: I was always, constantly searching for a way to make all the children smile.
それでも、頑張ればがんばるほど上手くいかないことが多くなる。: Even so, the harder I tried, the more things seemed to go wrong.
その度にお母さんがそばで励ましてくれた。: Every time that happened, my mother was by my side to encourage me.
“大丈夫”“無理をしないで”“先生だって完璧じゃない。間違えてもいいのよ”“あな: "It's okay." "Don't push yourself too hard." "Even teachers aren't perfect. It's okay to make mistakes." "This is the path you chose. For you, that makes it the right answer above all else."
お母さんが私にくれたたくさんの言葉は、今でも私の中で星の瞬きみたいに光ってる。: The many words my mother gave me still shine inside me even now, like twinkling stars.
それを思ってしまうと。: When I let myself think of that.
お母さんが遠いところに旅立った。: My mother had departed on a journey to a faraway place.
ひとりだ。ひとりぼっちになった。: I am alone. I ended up all alone.
いつまでもずっと味方だよと、笑顔をくれる人はもういない。どこにもいない。: The person who gave me a smile and told me she would always, forever be on my side is no longer here. She isn't anywhere.
子ども達を励ましたい。お母さんと同じ教師になる。私の“夢”は叶えられたけど……ひ: Wanting to encourage children. Becoming a teacher just like my mother. My "dream" came true, and yet... I lost one great big "dream."
それからというもの何もかもが上手くいかなくなった。: Ever since then, everything started going wrong.
いじめられっ子は子どもの世界だけじゃない、大人の世界にも、いるんだよ: "Bullied kids don't just exist in the world of children. They're in the adult world, too."
雨降りの中。休憩所のベンチに座り、誰にともなく私はつぶやいた。: In the falling rain. Sitting on the bench in the rest area, I murmured to no one in particular.
子どもの頃はまだよかった: "It was still better when I was a child."
気づけば誰かが守ってくれていた――いじめられていれば“かわいそうにね”と憐れんだ: "Before I knew it, someone would be protecting me--if I was being bullied, they would pity me, saying 'You poor thing,' or even share in my sadness."
……いじめはいけないことだと怒ってくれる人もいた。そういう大人が探せばどこかにひ: "...There were even people who got angry on my behalf, saying that bullying is wrong. If you looked, there was always at least one adult like that somewhere."
“悪”も“善”も、何より理解しやすい世界だった。: Above all else, it was a world where "good" and "evil" were easy to understand.
でも、大人になると途端に誰も守ってくれなくなる: "But the moment you become an adult, suddenly no one protects you anymore."
“わかるよ”って言って、やさしく手をつないでくれなくなる。弱い者には誰も近寄ろう: "No one says 'I understand' and gently holds your hand anymore. No one even tries to approach the weak. Because they don't want to be seen as weak themselves."
どころか“甘えるな”と叱られる。いけないことをそれはだめだと怒って、味方になって: "In fact, you get scolded and told to 'stop acting spoiled.' There's no longer anyone to get angry that wrong things are wrong, no one to take your side."
つらくても。悲しくても。さみしくても。自分で考えろと突っぱねられるだけでなく、“: "Even when it's painful. Even when it's sad. Even when you're lonely. Not only are you brushed off and told to figure it out yourself, but people use the word 'responsibility' as a shield... and blatantly get away with things more childish than anything a kid would do."
それが大人の世界だ。: That is the world of adults.
子どもな心を抱えたまま大人になると……つらい。: Growing into an adult while still holding onto a child's heart... is painful.
そんな心には悲しいことが鈴なりのようにしてやって来る。そんな“誰か”の言葉を思い: Sad things come piling upon a heart like that in droves. I ended up remembering the words of that "someone."
まだ私は大人になり切れていないのか。: Have I still not fully grown into an adult yet?
心が甘えん坊な子どものまま、なのか。: Is my heart still that of a spoiled child?
大切な人に大切に護られ続けてきた私の心は、人一倍に大切にされ過ぎたから……いつの: Because my heart, which was constantly and dearly protected by someone precious to me, was cherished far more than most... did it unknowingly become too fragile to take a hit?
……だから、大人になってもつらいことばかりが起こっているように思えて、しまうのか: Is that why I end up feeling like nothing but painful things happen even after becoming an adult?
……教えて。誰か、教えてよ。私は、ただ……: "...Tell me. Someone, please tell me. I just..."
ただ、誰かに、“そうだね、わかるよ、大変だったね”って、そう言ってほしくて……。: I just wanted someone to tell me, "That's right, I understand, you've had a really hard time"...
ただそれだけを求めて、私はここへこうして、やって来ただけなのに――……でも、誰に: Wishing for nothing more than that, I came here just like this--...and yet, from whom? Just who was I hoping to hear it from?
それを思い出せないことが何よりずっと悲しくて、私は泣いた。: Not being able to remember that was sadder than anything else, and I cried.
雨降りの雨粒よりもたくさん、たくさんの涙をこぼしてしまいたい。: I wanted to shed more, so many more tears than the raindrops falling from the sky.
そう想い、願い、ただただ泣いた。: Thinking that, wishing that, I simply cried and cried.
声がかけられた。: A voice called out to me.
待ち望んだ“誰か”がやって来た。: The "someone" I had been longing for had arrived.
するとそこには[・|男][・|の][・|人]が、立っていた。知らない人だ。: Standing there was a *man*. A stranger.
――何か、あったんですか？ 大丈夫ですか？: --Did something happen? Are you all right?
その人は心配そうに私の顔を覗き込んでいた。: He was peering into my face with a worried expression.
少し話すと、不思議だった。: After we talked for a little while, I found it strange.
その人も子どもの頃、雨の日になるとよくここにやって来ていたのだという。: He said that when he was a child, he used to come here often on rainy days, too.
ここでつらかったことをひとりで語る。: He would talk to himself about painful things right here.
そうするとなぜだかその夜はぐっすり眠れるようになったのだ、と。: And when he did, for some reason, he would be able to sleep soundly that night, he said.
たったひとりで雨降りの時間をここで過ごしていたはずだけど……。: I should have been spending the rainy hours here all by myself, and yet...

なぜだろう。その友だちに呼ばれたように思ったのだ。: Why was that? He said he felt as though that friend had called out to him.
だからふとした気まぐれみたいに来てみると、ひとりで泣いてる私を見つけたということ: So when he came here on what felt like a sudden whim, he found me crying all by myself.
私が待っていたのはこの人だろうか。: Was this the person I had been waiting for?
忘れたくないのに、絶対に、忘れちゃだめだったのに……。: Even though I didn't want to forget, even though I absolutely never should have forgotten...

どうして、大切な人と、私たちは“さよなら”をしなくちゃならないの……。: Why do we have to say "goodbye" to the people who are precious to us...?
そんなどうしようもない焦りだけがここにある。: Only that helpless sense of urgency remains here.
なんだか自分が、とってもひどいことをしてしまっているような気がして……。: For some reason, I felt like I had done something truly terrible...
破ってはいけない大切な“約束”を、平気な顔して破り捨ててしまっているような、気が: I felt as though I had casually broken and thrown away an important "promise" that never should have been broken, without a care in the world...
ごめん。ごめんね。ごめんなさい。: I'm sorry. I'm sorry. Please forgive me.
涙も、雨も、ごめんねも、[や|止]まずに流れ……。: The tears, the rain, and my apologies flowed endlessly without stopping...
足元にくしゃくしゃのチラシが流されてくる。: A crumpled flyer was washed toward my feet.

なぜだかとても気が合ったのだ。: For some reason, we got along remarkably well.
同時に、心の中に折れない光のような力強い“何か”を持っている人だった。: At the same time, he held "something" powerful inside his heart, like an unyielding light.

だからもう私たちは、ひとりぼっちになることだけは決してなかった。: And so, the two of us were never completely alone again.

どうやらその人の家は少し特殊な事情を抱えているようだった。: Apparently, his family had somewhat unusual circumstances.
端的に言えば芸事を受け継ぐ家系だ。: Simply put, they were a lineage that passed down traditional arts.
もう少し言えば、芸術家の一族……で、あるそうだ。: To elaborate a bit, they were a clan of artists... or so I was told.

その筋では一角の大家――というほどではないにしろ、先祖代々、古くからこの町に住み: While they weren't quite renowned masters in those circles, it seemed his ancestors had lived in this town for generations, since ancient times.
[・|し][・|き][・|た][・|り]などを重んじる家庭に入るのは中々に勇気の: Marrying into a household that placed such heavy value on *traditions* and the like certainly took a fair bit of courage.
気持ちを伝えたのはどちらが最初だっただろうか。: I wonder which of us confessed our feelings first?
私たちが[・|一][・|緒]になるのはなぜかとても自然なことのように思えた。: For some reason, the two of us *getting together* felt like the most natural thing in the world.
生涯を誓いあい、私は、あの人の……旦那の家業をサポートしながら教師を続けた。: We vowed to spend our lives together, and I continued working as a teacher while supporting his... my husband's family business.
たくさんだ。たくさん、たくさんの子たちを見送った。: There were so many. I saw off so, so many children.

さくらの花が散りゆくよりもずっと早く。足早に。: Much faster than cherry blossoms scatter. Briskly.
私たちの心にも身体にも、少しずつちょうどいい皺や傷も増えていき……。: Little by little, our hearts and bodies gained just the right amount of wrinkles and scars...

私たちはようやく子を成すことが叶った。: We were finally blessed with a child.

――私、どうしたらお父さんとお母さんに、大好きって言ってもらえるのかな。: --What can I do to make Father and Mother tell me they love me?
ある夜のこと。私は一緒に暮らすおばあさんにそう問いかけていた。: It happened one night. I was asking that question to the old woman who lived with me.

広い畳の部屋にいっぱいの鶴を作って並べていた。折り紙で鶴を千羽折ると願いが叶う。: I had made lots of paper cranes and lined them up across the wide tatami room. If you fold a thousand origami cranes, your wish will come true. That was something the world of picture books had taught me.
おまじないだったり。願掛けだったり。: Good luck charms. Prayers and wishes.

どうしてかおばあさんが私をきれいにしてくれた。: For some reason, the old woman cleaned me up and made me pretty.
かわいい洋服。整えたれた髪。: Cute western clothes. Neatly brushed hair.

列車の中と駅の構内。: Inside the train and on the station platform.

やはり一度に“四秒”、あるいは“五秒”は要してしまう。: As expected, it takes "four seconds" or "five seconds" at a time.
十夜から得た“十秒”も残りあと六秒……。: There were only six seconds left of the "ten seconds" I got from Toya...
慎重に、そして確実に、“力”を使わなければ。: I have to use the "power" carefully and with certainty.
そう自身に言い聞かせはしたけれど、だめだ。: I told myself that, but it was no good.
二度目も同じだ。: The second time was the same.
肩に触れた“影”はまったくの別人で……。: The "Shadow" whose shoulder I touched was a complete stranger...
今回は、少し早い。使用したのは三秒ほどだった。: This time was a little faster. I had used about three seconds.
しかしどうしたって選べやしない――“三秒後の風景”に、俺は唇を噛み、[まぶた|瞼: Even so, there was no way I could choose it--at the "scenery three seconds later," I bit my lip and opened my eyes.
……ごめんね大雅。役に立てなくて: "...I'm sorry, Taiga. That I couldn't be of much help."
隣にはしゅんとした顔の十夜がいた。: Beside me was Toya, looking crestfallen.
その手をお友だちが静かに繋ぎ、慰めている。: Her friend quietly held her hand, comforting her.
ううん。そんなことない。ありがとう十夜: "No, that's not true. Thank you, Toya."

だからもう一度、十夜にありがとうと伝える。そうして改めて、考えるのだ。: So I told Toya thank you once more. And then, I thought it over again.
未来視はあと三秒ほど残されている。: Only about three seconds of future sight remain.
（ぎりぎりもう一回くらいは試せるかもしれないが……）: (I might just barely be able to try one more time, but...)

……覚悟を、決めなくては。: I have to steel my resolve.
ふと目の前を通り過ぎた“影”: A "Shadow" suddenly passed right in front of me.
